title: Yaakov of Ofratayim
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat (14:13 in Hyman’s print; compare 14:3): “Rabbi Chunya, Yaakov of Ofratayim, in the name of Rabbi: ‘The Lord will remove from you every illness’—this means burning fever.”

notes.text: The consulted wording is at Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3; the supplied locator has ה״יג. The relation between the adjacent names Chunya and Yaakov is not supplied with an invented reporting verb. Burning fever translates שריפה in this illness gloss.

Hyman’s print (vol. II, p. 780) actually gives Shabbat chapter 14, halakhah 13. The wording is found at 14:3 in the consulted edition, where Chunya and Yaakov appear side by side without a reporting verb between them. “Every illness” completes the quoted verse, and “burning fever” translates the gloss that follows.
